title: Nomad Session Semantics
description: Language-neutral core model for Session, Turn, connection and freshness semantics. No encryption fields. Source: docs/technical/tasks/01-contract-security.md CON-001, PRD 6.

session_id.description: Opaque session identifier. Stable for the Session lifetime.

semantics_version.description: Semantic version of this contract. Compatibility is negotiated via capability negotiation at connection time, not via exact string equality. A Host declaring 1.x is compatible with a Mobile declaring 1.y where x >= minimum_supported_version for that major version.

turn_id.description: Current active turn identifier. Null when turn_state is None.

turn_state.description: Current turn lifecycle state. Completed/Cancelled/Failed/OutcomeUnknown are Turn outcomes, NOT Session terminal states.

host_connectivity.description: Host heartbeat presence within the valid window.

client_freshness.description: Whether the client has completed event gap and snapshot validation.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of last state update.

invariants.rule: If turn_state is None, turn_id MUST be null.
If turn_state is not None, turn_id MUST be a non-empty string.
A Session with turn_state=Completed/Cancelled/Failed/OutcomeUnknown MUST still be able to produce new Turns. Completed is not a Session terminal state.
Approval and Stop submissions MUST be rejected unless host_connectivity=Online AND client_freshness=Live.
turn_state and host_connectivity and client_freshness are ORTHOGONAL dimensions. No dimension may be inferred from or collapsed into another.

OutcomeUnknown -> Running MUST represent a new Turn started by the user, NOT a retry or resume of the original side effect. The original side effect remains in OutcomeUnknown and is never automatically re-executed.

unknown_state_strategy: Unknown or unrecognized states MUST fail closed: the receiver treats the field as protocol incompatibility and prevents safe operations (Approval, Stop).
